correctness.rationale: Exact beta-binomial formula (1) follows from Pólya membership exchangeability. Conditional on the complete descendant set, inside and outside retain independent uniform recursive-tree parent laws; deleting an early qualifying subtree preserves the fringe events of all later exterior roots. Induction separates disjoint roots (leading product) and nested roots (at least one additional O(1/n) inclusion), giving uniform joint rare-event estimates and all mixed factorial moments. These determine independent marked PPP limits. The earliest-label and uniform-mark laws follow from Poisson superposition. A standalone checker exhausted all trees through n=8 and passed 1,336 exact/deterministic assertions. Finite tests are supporting checks, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: An early vertex normally has a large fringe subtree. The first exception with bounded-size descendants is a natural extreme statistic with a square-root birth-label boundary. The equal intensity of all fixed sizes and uniform first-size mark, despite global counts declining as n/[s(s+1)], reveals a structural contrast not supplied by global CLTs or a single leaf process. The complete independent shape-marked process yields exact joint probabilities for successive early exceptions, not just a renamed marginal.
